environmentVariables.description: Base64 32-byte root key. Set it to enable encryption at rest and cryptographic erasure (forget() destroys the subject's key and signs the certificate). Without it, forget() is a logical delete and certificates are left unsigned.
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTARI_KEK

environmentVariables.description: Postgres DSN. Set it to use Postgres + pgvector instead of the default local SQLite file (concurrent access, indexed hybrid search).
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTARI_DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Where the default SQLite ledger lives.
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTARI_SQLITE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to offer the forget_subject tool (off by default, since erasure is irreversible and an agent can be steered by what it reads). When on, it is flagged destructive and takes two calls: a preview that returns a manifest hash, then a confirmation that passes it back.
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTARI_MCP_ALLOW_FORGET

environmentVariables.description: Enables Claude-powered fact extraction; falls back to the built-in regex extractor when unset.
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

server.name: io.github.attestd-io/attestd-mcp
server.description: CVE checks, supply chain signals, live catalog, and CVE detail for MCP clients (infra, PyPI, npm).

environmentVariables.description: Attestd API key (atst_...). Required for check_package_vulnerability, check_batch_vulnerabilities, get_cve_details, and live list_covered_products. Get one at https://api.attestd.io/portal
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTD_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL override. Defaults to https://api.attestd.io
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTD_BASE_URL

server.name: io.github.attestedintelligence/aga-mcp-server
server.description: Verifiable decision records for AI agents: signed receipts for calls to its own governed tools.

environmentVariables.description: Ed25519 seed, 64 hex characters, that signs this server's evidence-bundle receipts and checkpoint, so gateway_public_key (get_server_info) is the same after a restart and can be pinned. Set in your MCP client's configuration, the seed sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Receipts are kept in memory only; save a generate_evidence_bundle result before the server stops. Unset or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr. When set, even to an invalid value, AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE is not read.
environmentVariables.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the 64-hex Ed25519 seed; read only when AGA_GATEWAY_KEY is unset or empty, with the same effect. A stdio server started by your MCP client runs as the client's OS user, so the file sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Missing, unreadable or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr.
environmentVariables.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE

server.name: io.github.attestifyagent/attestify-mcp
server.description: MCP stdio server for Attestify OS — governed agent execution and Attestify Trust signed evidence.
server.title: Attestify OS

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the deployed Attestify app.
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTIFY_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Tenant API key issued via POST /api/keys, sent as X-API-Key on /api/run calls.
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTIFY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Attestify Trust agent ID, from a one-time `npx attestify trust-init` run. Enables attestify_trust_submit_evidence and attestify_trust_verify.
environmentVariables.name: TRUST_AGENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: That agent's Ed25519 private key (base64url), from the same trust-init run. Never leaves this server except as a signature.
environmentVariables.name: TRUST_PRIVATE_KEY

server.name: io.github.attestifyagent/attestify-os
server.description: Governed agent execution: x402 payments, budgets, receipts, verification, and audit.

environmentVariables.description: Tenant API key issued via POST /api/keys. Optional for discovery, required for governed /api/run calls.
environmentVariables.name: ATTESTIFY_API_KEY
